body.intent: Fix Flaky test on main: TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject (internal/api) fails about 1 run in 10 with 'TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: directory not empty'. Reproduced locally on an unmodified git archive of origin/main with go test -trimpath -count=10 -run TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject ./internal/api/ (found while verifying the #398 merge, 2026-11-08). Likely a goroutine or background process (web handler, daemon state write, or git) still writing into t.TempDir() after the test returns. Fix the root cause so -count=50 passes; don't add retries.
